items.title: TensorFold 1.3.3 speeds GLM-5.3-Flash decode by 13.8% after a million-token prompt on four GB10s
items.summary: TensorFold 1.3.3 reports GLM-5.3-Flash median drafted decode rising from 151.51 to 172.39 tok/s after a 1,040,384-token prompt on four GB10 machines at TP=4, with the same output tokens in that test.

doubt.pushback: Single-author benchmark on one hardware setup with no third-party reproduction seen; release notes link not resolved.

items.title: Omarchy adds Flowtunes, a local music generator, as a default app
items.summary: Omarchy's next update ships Flowtunes, an MIT-licensed app that generates endless music locally in one of 12 genres using Omarchy's local music model, with no cloud or ads.

doubt.pushback: Announcement with a demo clip; quality of the generated music and hardware needs not measured in the post.

saved_rejected.reason: Weekly recap video with no first-hand detail in the post.
Personal testimonial about a tool, no new capability or result.
